purpose: IFS Cloud WFM/manufacturing semantic value mapping and next proof action.

automationOpportunities: join shop-order/operation/resource demand to WFM availability plus skills/qualifications to identify qualified shortages before overtime or agency labour is committed
join material availability/WIP/purchasing to workforce capacity so material-constrained work is not misdiagnosed as a labour shortage
join machine downtime and maintenance schedules to workforce plans to redeploy qualified labour and coordinate maintenance windows
reconcile IFS shop-floor clockings/labor reports to authoritative WFM attendance/pay calculations to surface payroll and job-cost exceptions without treating ERP clockings as payroll truth
join scrap/non-conformance and operation/resource context to workforce skills/training history to prioritize training hypotheses while preserving competing changes
join resource, work-center, labor/material/overhead costs and production output to WFM labor cost for labor-per-order and labor-per-good-unit finance attribution
use one reviewed cross-domain IFS connection to accelerate implementation for smaller manufacturers while source-scoped instance/company/site/projection namespaces support global multi-entity estates
savingsHypotheses: reduce avoidable overtime and agency spend by separating genuine qualified-labour shortages from material, machine and maintenance constraints
reduce paid idle time by preventing scarce labor from being allocated to operations that are not materially or mechanically ready
reduce payroll/job-cost discrepancies by reconciling WFM attendance/pay authority with shop-floor labor/clocking evidence
reduce rework cost by linking scrap/non-conformance to operation/resource/skills context while retaining causal uncertainty
reduce implementation effort where one IFS estate can populate workforce, production, maintenance, quality, inventory/procurement and finance semantic domains through reviewed APIs

preserve recommendation/action identifiers and baseline/outcome windows for redeployment, overtime, training or maintenance interventions
